image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sea lion resting on a dark, rocky surface. The animal's head and upper torso are visible, showing wet, sleek fur that transitions from dark grey/brown to lighter silver-grey highlights due to lighting. Key features include visible external ear flaps, prominent whiskers, and closed eyes. A portion of another sea lion is visible in the background.
